scope: cyclone-dashboard/src (components + api client) vs integration_api /api/analyze response contract
method: Documentary mapping of the live AnalyzeResponse blocks (from e2e_trace.json response object and integration_api/schemas.py) against the fields each React component consumes. No values invented; honours e2e output including honest nulls.

post_audit_addition.note: Added 2026-08-30 (Option A). Documented after the /api/image endpoint and HistoryEditor were implemented and verified (19 new tests + live HTTP).

image_endpoint.request: user satellite image bytes (never a filesystem path on the server; filename used only as a display label)
image_endpoint.frontend_consumer: SatelliteViewer (uploadSatelliteImage), reworked to show selected/uploading/done/failed states; result surfaced via App onImageResult -> ProvenancePanel(image provenance)

honest_handling.detection.location/movement: null (no localizer, no motion without history)
honest_handling.no_forecast_landfall_risk: absent by design for an image alone

history_input_parameterization.change: fetchAnalyze(history?, meta?) now accepts an optional validated 5x6h history from the HistoryEditor; the POST /api/analyze snake_case body contract is unchanged
history_input_parameterization.client_side_validation: exactly 5 obs, 6h spacing, chronological, bounded ranges, NaN/non-finite rejected
history_input_parameterization.editor_controls: add observation / per-row delete / clear / reset-to-demo / run forecast; DISABLED submit while invalid
history_input_parameterization.demo_vs_user_label: HistoryEditor header switches DEMO DATA -> USER-EDITED HISTORY on any edit; demo never shown as user/model inference
history_input_parameterization.server_side_authority: phase-6 rules re-applied; invalid history -> 422 structured error, never silently repaired
history_input_parameterization.provenance_distinction: /api/analyze (custom history) has no image_source label (reference frame path); /api/image has image_source=USER-UPLOADED IMAGE

nio_policy_guard.added: 2026-08-30 (P1). Documented after the upstream North-Indian-Ocean guard was implemented and verified (13 new tests + live HTTP).
nio_policy_guard.policy: Input is accepted for /api/analyze, /api/detect, /api/classify, /api/forecast ONLY when every history observation lies inside the North Indian Ocean box: lat in [0, 30] deg N and lon in [40, 100] deg E (canonical degrees-East [0,360)).
nio_policy_guard.violation: 422 OUT_OF_DOMAIN; message states the request is 'rejected, not clamped' (no silent clamping/repair).

examples_verified.boundaries: lat 0/30 and lon 40/100 accepted; just outside rejected
examples_verified.non_finite: NaN/Inf latin -> 422 NON_FINITE_VALUE (phase-6 finite check fires first)

nio_policy_guard.scope: allowed_integration only; phase-6 global physical bounds unchanged; no phase artifact modified

optional_or_null_fields.frontend_handling: ChartsPanel/MapView filter out falsy pressure values; not plotted
ForecastCard shows 'Awaiting data'; MapView popup hides when falsy
SatelliteViewer renders no bounding box overlay; honest 'Not available' note

optional_or_null_fields.value: false (independent eval VERIFIED: acc 47.0% / macro-F1 0.3703 / wind MAE 18.84; still not servable in-process because the defining module lives only in the no-extraction zip)
optional_or_null_fields.frontend_handling: ProvenancePanel reflects the honest NOT_available state with the precise reason

backend_fields_not_displayed: meta.source (long descriptive string; displayed in provenance rather than top-level)

field_name_aliases_handled_by_components.hour vs hours: backend uses 'hour' (6/12/24); components read p.hours ?? p.hour
field_name_aliases_handled_by_components.lat/lon vs latitude/longitude: backend uses lat/lon; components read p.latitude ?? p.lat
field_name_aliases_handled_by_components.windSpeedKmh vs wind_speed_kmh: backend uses windSpeedKmh; components read p.wind_speed_kmh ?? p.windSpeedKmh

contract_input_aliases_client_sends.history[].{lat,lon,timestamp,wind_speed_: client.js writes DEMO_HISTORY in the snake_case keys the schema expects
contract_input_aliases_client_sends.meta.title: client sends systemName/systemId/basin/lastPass as required by schema

mock_only_fields_not_sent_by_live_backen: static high-confidence dummy map cone widths (illustrative cone only; live backend sends no uncertainty)
hard-coded demo acquisition time string (replaced by meta.lastPass in the honesty fix)
